name: negative-shell-without-socket
description: Shell exec with stdio redirection but NO socket connect, NOT a reverse shell. A non-login shell (bash -i) is exec'd and redirects fds via dup2, but it never opens an outbound network connection (no network.dst_port event in this process generation). The sequence's socket-connect step is never satisfied, so the sequence is incomplete (no alert). This guards against flagging local shell pipelines and scripts that dup fds without any network. Expect no match.
